scope: Planner 全图按需检索与本轮先查后建；保留原工作区意图检索权限修复
changes: 独立权限过滤和聚合计数 SQL；启动无默认类别列表，图引导最多 8000 Unicode 字符、相关记录总计最多 8 条。
事件节点、直接父节点、产出及同资产活跃意图按层级选择；纯心跳最多两个按实际最近活动时间排序的运行中意图，无最新 300 条限制。
主 Agent 和目标 API 事件传递精确节点 ID；事件文本不作为引导内容来源，关联任务仅直接只读并共用预算。
Planner 每轮私有查询记录，成功检索 intent 且完成实际分页链才能新增；逐资产（含父节点继承）或无资产方向关键词校验，拒绝返回可执行查询参数。
提交入口冻结查询记录，排队中的写操作不能被并发尚未完成的查询追认；精确重复继续复用，批量部分成功。
图引导摘要在模型请求前复核授权，只修改请求投影；查询失败不伪装为空，原始目标和专用约束仍保留。
权限与默认提示词独立一次性迁移，保留禁用/未绑定工具、跨任务限制与自定义提示词；不新增业务表或列。
去掉 Planner 的整队列读取和旧事件正文预载代码；引导只读事务 SET LOCAL jit=off，避免 LLVM 编译开销且不影响连接池其他请求。

validation.db: full suite passed, including new bootstrap, approval/source visibility, state, priority, heartbeat and migrations
validation.agent: full suite passed; final targeted race tests passed after ledger, recovery and authorization projection changes
validation.server: full suite passed; final real Planner direct/deferred/noa/round isolation and lifecycle focused runs passed
validation.test_environment: disposable PostgreSQL 17 container, separate package databases; all data/migration/runtime tests used explicit isolated DSNs. Final compile check also used the isolated DSN. Earlier compile-only runs had no database environment or package-local config and ran no migrations or tests.
validation.baseline_method: git archive 78ab23f into isolated temporary directory; same planning scenario test copied there and run with its previous valid add-only sequence
validation.tokens: No real model usage; characters and bytes are not Token measurements.

measurement_notes: Graph-only measurements use 3 iterations; SQL statement counts include transaction control. The previous bounded overview remains a test-only baseline.
Planning scenario measures one successful new direction with a mock model. First-request text excludes tool schemas, JSON framing and other protocol overhead.
New normal scenario uses search + add (2 tools, 3 mock requests), versus previous add-only (1 tool, 2 mock requests). Extra retrieval turn is an intentional safety/correctness tradeoff.

Elapsed times and allocations are local synthetic-fixture measurements, not production latency or real model network latency. Graph count queries still scale with graph/lineage complexity and have a 5s timeout.
Graph guide is bounded; original mission, constraints, dynamic suppression feedback and SDK-managed conversation history are outside this graph budget. No whole-request Token hard cap is claimed.
limitations: The query gate proves an eligible successful query was made; it does not guarantee semantic deduplication across paraphrases.
Only current-run successful query receipts count, including after in-run compression; new runs/restarts require fresh queries.
User-facing/frontend behavior, SDK, persisted original conversations and audits are unchanged.
No Git commit, business service restart, release or remote push performed.
